invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new ArrayList, so result cannot be null.
clusteringGroup is dereferenced via clusteringGroup.getSlices(), so it must not be null.
result is always an instance of List from ArrayList instantiation.
Any List in Java, including an ArrayList, has a non-negative size.
clusteringGroup.getSlices() is used to obtain clusteringOps, so it must not be null.
